NEW: The cape-wearing man accused of striking Turning Point USA students with a cane at UT Tyler has been identified as Ciro Tomlian, a former student.

Video shows him throwing an American flag, making obscene gestures and swinging a cane at people near the conservative student

BREAKING: Former NFL head coach and ESPN analyst Rex Ryan has turned himself in and faces hit-and-run charges following a crash in Nashville last week.

Police say two people were injured in the crash.
